messages:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGER fired: inference-gateway-prod-usw2 - 502 error rate spike detected (rolling 5m > 12%). Trigger: gateway_5xx_rate > threshold. Pager: pagerduty#prod-inference (link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-12345)

pagerduty: Incident INC-12345 created and routed to primary on-call. Severity: P1. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/inference-5xx

maya: acked. I'm on it, pulling up dashboards now. @jordan @sam if you see anything obvious pls flag.

jordan: +1 ack. Any customer-impact notes from the alert?

maya: Initial look: 502s concentrated on /v1/generate proxied to inference-gateway fronting a model pool. 60% of 5xxs are coming from path /v1/generate?batch=true (batching path). Premium routes look fine so far.

sam: copying runbook steps: 1) verify ingress pod health 2) check kvcache eviction 3) confirm backend pool instance status 4) route fallback (if available)

maya: running quick checks: kubectl --context prod get pods -n gateway -l app=inference-gateway -o wide

maya: ```
# kubectl output (trimmed)
NAME                                  READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
inference-gateway-5c7b8f6d9-abcde      1/1     Running   0          3d   node-az2-1
inference-gateway-5c7b8f6d9-fghij      0/1     CrashLoop  5          23h  node-az3-4
```

jordan: crashlooping pod on node-az3-4 — could be bad NIC or oom? Any OOM logs?

maya: grabbing logs: kubectl -n gateway logs inference-gateway-5c7b8f6d9-fghij --previous

maya: ```
E0501 14:12:33.123 main.go:452] runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
stack: ...
```

sam: nil pointer in gateway process, likely a recent code path hit by batched requests. Was there a deploy in last 24h?

maya: Deploy history: deploybot shows inference-gateway v2.14.2 rolled 30h ago. No deploy in the last 2h.

jordan: customer impact: based on tracing sampling, 9% of requests from non-critical clients are failing; latency for successful requests unaffected. Recommend fallback routing to stable gateway variant and temporarily disable batching path for production traffic while we triage.

maya: Initiating fallback: switching traffic slice away from node-az3-4 pool to stable pool (runbook step). Command: 

maya: ```bash
# temporarily remove node from LB pool
aasctl lb pool remove-node --pool inference-gateway-prod --node node-az3-4 --reason "502 spike -> remove until repro"
```

incident-bot: ACTION: node-az3-4 removed from LB pool by maya at 2025-05-01T14:18:45Z. Rate re-eval in 2 minutes.

pagerduty: Escalation policy: not escalated further (ack by maya). If not resolved in 10m, auto-escalate to secondary.

maya: after removing node, 502 rate dropped to ~3.1% (now trending). We're seeing fewer crashloops.

sam: good. can we also toggle batching off as quick mitigation? We can flip feature flag via FF service.

maya: toggling batching flag for prod: ffctl set inference-batching prod false --cause "mitigate 502 spike"

maya: incident-bot: FEATURE FLAG change: inference-batching -> prod = false (applied by maya).

jordan: monitoring: please keep an eye on customer SLA routes. If any premium customers see errors, notify immediately.

maya: Premium routes still clean. Error rate now at 0.9% after the two mitigations. Metrics: gateway_5xx_rate 0.9% (5m).

sam: excellent. Next steps: collect heap/profile from the crashing binary, capture core if possible, and open follow-up ticket to rollback or patch the nil deref. Maya can you collect logs and attach to INC-12345?

maya: grabbing core/logs, will attach. Also creating follow-up issue: INF-4572 with triage checklist and owner @jordan.

oncall-rotation: thanks team — marking incident as 'mitigated'. Keep incident open until postmortem/INF-4572 created. If error rate holds <1% for 30m, we'll close the PD incident.

maya: attached logs + temporary metrics snapshot to the PD incident and INF-4572. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-12345 and https://go/issues/INF-4572

incident-bot: METRIC: gateway_5xx_rate = 0.8% (5m) at 2025-05-01T14:45:11Z. Auto-close timer started: 30m stable window required.

jordan: note for postmortem: verify batching codepath sanity checks, add defensive nil checks, and add e2e test for batch=true path.

sam: assigning follow-up tasks: INF-4572 owner jordan, priority P1 bugfix, include canary of fix to small region before global roll.

maya: closing loop here: no customer-facing incidents reported by CSMs. Will update #customer-impact if anything changes. Good job. :thumbsup:

oncall-rotation: closing PD incident after stable window. Marking on-call handoff note in calendar.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-12345 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Closed by automation at 2025-05-01T15:15:11Z.
